summary.business_type: Developer Tools & UI Asset Directory (SaaS/Directory Hybrid)

top_findings.title: Missing robots.txt & XML Sitemap due to SPA Wildcard Catch-all
top_findings.impact: Search engine crawlers receiving HTML with DOCTYPE for sitemap.xml and robots.txt, causing indexing failure.

top_findings.title: Missing Canonical Tag
top_findings.impact: No <link rel='canonical'> leaves site vulnerable to duplicate content indexing across Vercel deployment URLs.

top_findings.title: Total Absence of Schema.org Structured Data
top_findings.impact: 0 JSON-LD blocks found. Missing WebSite, WebApplication, and ItemList schema for 28,047 templates and 897 components.

top_findings.title: Missing Open Graph & Twitter Social Metadata
top_findings.impact: Links shared across X, Discord, Slack, and LinkedIn generate blank snippet cards without rich media.

top_findings.title: Agentic & AI Search Soft-404 / Catch-all 200
top_findings.impact: /llms.txt and /.well-known/ai-catalog.json return HTML status 200, failing Lighthouse Agentic and AI engine ingestion.

quick_wins: Create public/robots.txt with sitemap reference and dedicated AI crawler access rules.
Create public/sitemap.xml and public/llms.txt for search engines and AI agents.
Add canonical tag and Open Graph/Twitter Card meta tags to index.html.
Inject WebSite and WebApplication JSON-LD schema into index.html.

findings.title: Missing Canonical URL declaration
findings.description: The page does not declare a canonical URL tag (<link rel='canonical'>).
findings.recommendation: Add <link rel='canonical' href='https://entele-visuals.vercel.app/' /> to <head> in index.html.

findings.title: Wildcard rewrite serving HTML for robots.txt & sitemap.xml
findings.description: sitemap.xml returns HTTP 200 with HTML DOCTYPE ('DOCTYPE is not allowed in sitemap XML'). robots.txt also serves HTML.
findings.recommendation: Provide real static public/robots.txt and public/sitemap.xml files in Vite public directory.

findings.title: Client-Side Rendering (SPA) shell without fallback content
findings.description: Initial HTML payload contains only 8 words and empty root div before hydration.
findings.recommendation: Include static noscript / pre-rendered semantic HTML fallback inside index.html for non-JS bots.

findings.title: Zero Schema.org JSON-LD blocks detected
findings.description: parse_html and render_page found 0 JSON-LD blocks.
findings.recommendation: Inject WebSite, Organization, and WebApplication JSON-LD markup.

findings.title: Missing llms.txt standard file
findings.description: /llms.txt returns soft-404 HTML instead of Markdown.
findings.recommendation: Create a compliant public/llms.txt with H1, blockquote summary, and curated platform links.

findings.title: Lack of semantic anchor links (<a>)
findings.description: Template filtering and navigation use button and div elements, blocking crawler link traversal.
findings.recommendation: Ensure key navigation categories and template details use semantic anchor tags.

findings.title: Missing Open Graph and Twitter Card tags
findings.description: No og:title, og:description, og:image, twitter:card tags exist in index.html.
findings.recommendation: Add complete Open Graph and Twitter summary_large_image tags.

findings.title: Weak H1/H2 heading hierarchy
findings.description: Current H1 is 'Describe your site. We’ll find the template.' and 0 H2 tags are defined in the DOM.
findings.recommendation: Structure headings with brand/entity H1 and descriptive H2s for Categories and Features.
